arabic: إِنَّ مَعَ الْعُسْرِ يُسْرًا
translation: Indeed, with hardship comes ease.

arabic: وَمَن يَتَّقِ اللَّهَ يَجْعَل لَّهُ مَخْرَجًا
translation: And whoever fears Allah — He will make for him a way out.

arabic: وَاصْبِرْ وَمَا صَبْرُكَ إِلَّا بِاللَّهِ
translation: Be patient, and your patience is only through Allah.

arabic: وَاللَّهُ خَيْرٌ حَافِظًا ۖ وَهُوَ أَرْحَمُ الرَّاحِمِينَ
translation: Allah is the best guardian, and He is the Most Merciful of the merciful.

arabic: وَمَا تَوْفِيقِي إِلَّا بِاللَّهِ
translation: My success is only through Allah.

arabic: وَمَن يَعْمَلْ مِنَ الصَّالِحَاتِ وَهُوَ مُؤْمِنٌ فَلَا يَخَافُ ظُلْمًا وَلَا هَضْمًا
translation: Whoever does righteous deeds while a believer — he will neither fear injustice nor deprivation.

arabic: وَاذْكُر رَّبَّكَ إِذَا نَسِيتَ
translation: And remember your Lord when you forget.

arabic: أَلَا بِذِكْرِ اللَّهِ تَطْمَئِنُّ الْقُلُوبُ
translation: Surely in the remembrance of Allah do hearts find rest.

arabic: وَقُل رَّبِّ زِدْنِي عِلْمًا
translation: And say: My Lord, increase me in knowledge.

arabic: فَاذْكُرُونِي أَذْكُرْكُمْ وَاشْكُرُوا لِي وَلَا تَكْفُرُونِ
translation: So remember Me; I will remember you. And be grateful to Me and do not deny Me.

arabic: وَبَشِّرِ الصَّابِرِينَ
translation: And give good news to the patient.

arabic: يَا أَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا اسْتَعِينُوا بِالصَّبْرِ وَالصَّلَاةِ
translation: O you who believe, seek help through patience and prayer.

arabic: رَبِّ اشْرَحْ لِي صَدْرِي ۝ وَيَسِّرْ لِي أَمْرِي
translation: My Lord, expand for me my chest and ease my affair.

arabic: حَسْبُنَا اللَّهُ وَنِعْمَ الْوَكِيلُ
translation: Sufficient for us is Allah, and the best of disposers.

arabic: قُل لَّن يُصِيبَنَا إِلَّا مَا كَتَبَ اللَّهُ لَنَا هُوَ مَوْلَانَا ۚ وَعَلَى اللَّهِ فَلْيَتَوَكَّلِ الْمُؤْمِنُونَ
translation: Say: Nothing will befall us except what Allah has decreed for us. He is our Protector — and upon Allah let the believers rely.

arabic: إِنَّ اللَّهَ مَعَ الَّذِينَ اتَّقَوا وَّالَّذِينَ هُم مُّحْسِنُونَ
translation: Indeed, Allah is with those who fear Him and those who do good.

arabic: وَمَن يَتَوَكَّلْ عَلَى اللَّهِ فَهُوَ حَسْبُهُ
translation: And whoever places his trust in Allah — He is sufficient for him.

arabic: لَا يُكَلِّفُ اللَّهُ نَفْسًا إِلَّا وُسْعَهَا
translation: Allah does not burden a soul beyond what it can bear.

arabic: وَجَنَّةٍ عَرْضُهَا السَّمَاوَاتُ وَالْأَرْضُ أُعِدَّتْ لِلْمُتَّقِينَ
translation: And a garden as wide as the heavens and the earth, prepared for those who fear Allah.

arabic: وَاسْتَعِينُوا بِالصَّبْرِ وَالصَّلَاةِ ۚ وَإِنَّهَا لَكَبِيرَةٌ إِلَّا عَلَى الْخَاشِعِينَ
translation: And seek help through patience and prayer — indeed it is heavy except upon the humble.

arabic: إِنَّمَا أَشْكُو بَثِّي وَحُزْنِي إِلَى اللَّهِ
translation: I only complain of my grief and sorrow to Allah.

arabic: فَاذْكُرُوا اللَّهَ كَذِكْرِكُمْ آبَاءَكُمْ أَوْ أَشَدَّ ذِكْرًا
translation: So remember Allah as you remember your fathers — or with much more remembrance.

arabic: وَأُفَوِّضُ أَمْرِي إِلَى اللَّهِ ۚ إِنَّ اللَّهَ بَصِيرٌ بِالْعِبَادِ
translation: And I entrust my affair to Allah. Indeed, Allah is All-Seeing of His servants.

arabic: وَعَسَىٰ أَن تَكْرَهُوا شَيْئًا وَهُوَ خَيْرٌ لَّكُمْ ۖ وَعَسَىٰ أَن تُحِبُّوا شَيْئًا وَهُوَ شَرٌّ لَّكُمْ
translation: Perhaps you dislike a thing and it is good for you, and perhaps you love a thing and it is bad for you.

arabic: فَإِنَّ مَعَ الْعُسْرِ يُسْرًا ۝ إِنَّ مَعَ الْعُسْرِ يُسْرًا
translation: For indeed, with hardship will be ease; indeed with hardship will be ease.

arabic: رَبَّنَا آتِنَا فِي الدُّنْيَا حَسَنَةً وَفِي الْآخِرَةِ حَسَنَةً وَقِنَا عَذَابَ النَّارِ
translation: Our Lord, give us good in this world and good in the Hereafter, and save us from the punishment of the Fire.

arabic: قُلْ يَا عِبَادِيَ الَّذِينَ أَسْرَفُوا عَلَىٰ أَنفُسِهِمْ لَا تَقْنَطُوا مِن رَّحْمَةِ اللَّهِ
translation: Say: O My servants who have transgressed against themselves, do not despair of the mercy of Allah.

arabic: وَإِذَا سَأَلَكَ عِبَادِي عَنِّي فَإِنِّي قَرِيبٌ
translation: And when My servants ask you concerning Me — indeed I am near.

arabic: إِنَّ اللَّهَ يُحِبُّ التَّوَّابِينَ وَيُحِبُّ الْمُتَطَهِّرِينَ
translation: Indeed, Allah loves those who constantly repent, and He loves those who purify themselves.

arabic: فَسَبِّحْ بِحَمْدِ رَبِّكَ وَاسْتَغْفِرْهُ ۚ إِنَّهُ كَانَ تَوَّابًا
translation: So glorify the praises of your Lord and seek His forgiveness. Indeed, He is ever accepting of repentance.
